dossier_meta.catalog_title: Question (Riemannian surfaces): supremum of cop number for geometrically bounded surfaces
dossier_meta.statement_text: What is the supremum of the cop numbers taken over all surfaces whose cut locus is at least $1$ and whose area is at most $\alpha$? Is it bounded?
dossier_meta.context_text: The author asks whether restricting to Riemannian surfaces with a positive lower bound on the injectivity radius and an upper bound on total area is enough to guarantee a finite supremum for the cop number.
